column3: “Did not a brother Esau belong to Jacob” is rendered “Was not Esau Jacob’s brother?”; NASB adds “Yet.”
“For” is rendered “Though,” and “shattered” “beaten down”; “a territory of wickedness” is rendered “the wicked territory.”
“He is great … over the border” is rendered “The LORD be magnified beyond the border”; NASB adds “this.”
“Bringing near” is rendered “presenting,” and “despicable” “to be despised.”
“Lift up your face” is rendered “receive you kindly,” and “bring it near” “Why not offer it.”
“Entreat the face of God” is rendered “entreat God’s favor”; “from your hand was this” is rendered “With such an offering on your part.”
“Who also is among you” is rendered “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the gates”; “in vain” is rendered “uselessly.”
“Is great” is rendered “will be great,” and “offering” “a grain offering.”
“What weariness!” is rendered “My, how tiresome it is!”; “a stolen animal” is rendered “what was taken by robbery,” and NASB adds “disdainfully.”
“One who deals deceptively” is rendered “the swindler,” and “a blemished animal” “a blemished animal”; NASB adds “but.”
